messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HOSTED-API queue growth alert for region us-west-2. p95 latency 3.2s -> 12.8s, p99 9.6s -> 42.1s in last 5m. GPU pool utilization 100%. queue_depth: 18k -> 94k. Autoscaler attempts failing (quota limit). Paging on-call.

Lee: I'm on it. digging into autoscaler logs and queue metrics. tagging @Anna for handoff if needed.

Anna: on call. what's the initial impact? any customer 5xx spikes?

Jess: Seeing a big spike in upstream timeouts. Top complainants: acme-inc and metrics-ingest pipeline. Support tickets inflating. Will patch customers with a notice.

Max: Autoscaler is hitting cloud GPU quota for us-west-2: GPU_QUOTA=120, desired replicas=140. Requests to cloud to raise quota are pending and failing with policy error. Found an autoscale loop error: "failed to provision: quota_exceeded" repeatedly since 09:12:08 UTC.

Priya: Model routing shows >80% of incoming requests are routed to gpt-xxl-8k (default). Smaller model variants gpt-xxl-4k-quant are available but not currently in fallback list for this route.

Lee: Key numbers: total qps 26k (peak), sustained 18k. Token throughput spike correlates with a single client sending large batch requests. p50 latency 1.1s -> 1.8s, p95 12.8s, p99 42s, client timeouts rising to 8% for last 10m.

Sam: Any chance we can route non-SLA traffic to a best-effort pool? We have reserved Dedicated capacity idle in eu-central but can't serve us-west due to region constraints.

Anna: Short term mitigations: 1) enable per-customer circuit-breaker for top offenders 2) add fallback routing to quantized model 3) shed low-priority requests via rate limit. Who can toggle those rails?

Max: I can flip the global rate limiter for anonymous and non-auth traffic to 10rps per key. running:
``
redwoodctl rate-limit update --scope=global --policy=emergency-10rps
```
Applying now.

incident-bot: rate-limit update accepted. enforcement on in 8s.

Priya: Adding a routing override to prefer gpt-xxl-4k-quant for the default hosted route. Command:
``
redwoodctl route update hosted-default --fallback-model gpt-xxl-4k-quant --priority=50
```
Applying; will take effect as new requests enter the routing layer.

Lee: Kicking off a manual pool scale to add 16 extra GPUs from burst pool, but provider is returning quota error. Attempting a different pool in us-west-2a.

Max: Confirmed provider error: "quota_exceeded: requested GPUs exceed account regional limit". Support ticket to cloud provider created (TICKET-98321). ETA unknown.

Jess: Notifying affected customers: sending status update to enterprise contacts for acme-inc and metrics-ingest. Template: "We're seeing elevated request latency due to infrastructure pressure; mitigation in progress." Posting updates.

Sam: Could we temporarily route some traffic to eu region with increased latency? Might be acceptable for non-latency-sensitive batch workloads.

Priya: Cross-region routing would require model replication and routing policy updates — can do for a subset. I'll prepare a selective reroute for clients with no geo constraint.

Lee: Immediate visible effects after rate limiter + fallback: queue_depth dropped from 94k -> 38k over 6 minutes. p95 improved to 6.4s, p99 -> 18.2s. Timeouts still elevated but trending down.

Anna: Good. Keep the per-customer circuit-breaker on high offenders. Jess, confirm which keys we throttled and send a note to sales for outreach.

Jess: Throttled keys: acme-prod (75% reduction), ingest-batch (90% reduction). Notifying sales and customer success now. Jira created: CS-6521.

Max: Cloud provider replied: they can raise quota by 20 GPUs but require business justification and 4h lead time. That won't solve the immediate burst.

Lee: Next step: move non-critical routes to quantized variant (done), keep global rate limiting enforced, and enable request-priority queueing so SLA customers get precedence.

Priya: Priority queueing enabled for auth tokens with enterprise tier. Verified routing tags applied. p95 for enterprise tokens now 1.3s.

Anna: OK handoff plan: Lee, you'll continue overseeing immediate mitigation and metrics until handoff. Anna will take next 2hr watch and coordinate cloud quota escalation & follow-ups. State: "mitigated" when overall p99 < 10s and queue < 10k.

Lee: Agreed. Current metrics: p95 4.2s, p99 12.1s, queue_depth 9.8k. We're almost at the mitigation threshold.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0723-01. Severity: Sev2. Start: 1766009876. Mitigation in progress.

Sam: Long-term asks: 1) add smaller default model to fallback list 2) add cross-region warm pool 3) autoscaler should pre-check cloud quotas before ramping desired replicas.

Max: Adding an autoscaler improvement ticket: INFRA-1409 (preflight quota check + safer backoff). Also request expanding reserved capacity for high-risk customers: SALES + FIN to review pricing options.

Jess: Customer impact summary to stakeholders: Acme-inc had 12-minute elevated error window, ingest-pipeline had 9-minute failures with retries. No data loss reported. Ops provided workaround and priority queue applied.

Lee: Marking incident as mitigated. p99 steady ~6.2s, p95 1.6s, queue_depth 4.1k. Manual intervention: global rate-limiter, routing fallback to quantized model, priority queueing enabled. Cloud quota request still pending.

Anna: Taking watch. Handoff notes: ongoing tasks
- Follow up with cloud provider for full quota increase (Max)
- Backfill autoscaler preflight checks (Lee + Infra)
- Postmortem and RCA (owner: Lee)
- Customer follow-ups + CS ticket closure (Jess)
- Product review for fallback model defaults (Sam)

Priya: Collecting logs for eval and promptset regression checks to ensure quantized model didn't degrade outputs significantly. Will run A/B evals against sample traffic.

Lee: Quick commands run during incident for audit:
``
redwoodctl route update hosted-default --fallback-model gpt-xxl-4k-quant --priority=50
redwoodctl rate-limit update --scope=global --policy=emergency-10rps
redwoodctl queue priority enable --tiers=enterprise
```
Saved audit entries to INC-2026-0723-01.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0723-01 status updated to "Mitigated - monitoring" by Lee.

Anna: If anything regresses ping me. I'll loop in postmortem meeting invite for tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Closing slack thread for now.

Jess: Posting status update to customers and closing immediate tickets. Will reopen if rollback observed.

Sam: Thanks team. We'll coordinate product/infra follow-ups in the ticket tracker.

Priya: I'll publish initial evaluation of quality delta from quantized fallback by EOD.

Lee: Leaving final note: root cause = sudden client-driven token QPS spike + autoscaler blind ramp hitting cloud quota. Short-term mitigations worked. Postmortem to cover autoscaler safety checks and fallback defaults.

Anna: Handoff complete. ending watch. last metrics snapshot attached to incident.
